content: {"summary":"Customers report that Xbox Live Gold purchases often activate only for free games, not for online multiplayer or party features, causing frustration when invitations or game launches prompt for a new purchase. Many users have confirmed the issue across multiple consoles, noting that the Gold status appears in settings but multiplayer remains inaccessible. Rebooting, deleting profiles, or resetting the console does not resolve the problem, indicating a systemic activation error. The recurring theme is that Gold membership is not fully recognized by the system, leading to repeated purchase prompts and a negative user experience."}
